briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek-R2 escalate AGI compute arms race amid safety gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 9 major models this month as compute spending hit record quarterly levels. Prompt injection vulnerabilities persist across production deployments while regulatory momentum builds in the US and EU.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4 with 4.1T parameters and native multi-agent orchestration. DeepSeek-R2 matched o3 performance at 40% lower inference cost. Anthropic and Google DeepMind both deployed internal successors to Claude 4 and Gemini 2.5.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and CoreWeave announced 180k H200 cluster expansions. TSMC reported 2nm yield improvements benefiting next-gen AI accelerators from NVIDIA and AMD.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems before 2027?
